title: ClickHouse Parts & Merges
subtitle: Part lifecycle from part_log plus the current parts snapshot. Table names are de-anonymized for the reader; part names and partition values stay masked. Micro-batching and merge storms surface here first.

panels.text:
## Why parts matter
Every insert creates a part; merges fold parts together in the background. Too many small parts (micro-batching) inflates metadata and merge load; too few large merges can stall. This view mirrors the *clickhouse-part-log* and *clickhouse-merges* skills: the event mix tells you whether writes are well-batched, and the per-table ranking points at the tables driving merge pressure.

panels.query: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.parts WHERE active) AS active_parts, countIf(event_type = 'NewPart') AS new_parts, countIf(event_type = 'MergeParts') AS merges, round(avgIf(duration_ms, event_type = 'MergeParts')) AS avg_merge_ms FROM system_anon.part_log WHERE event_date > today() - 7

panels.title: Part event mix (7d)
panels.query: SELECT event_type AS label, count() AS n FROM system_anon.part_log WHERE event_date > today() - 7 GROUP BY label ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: New parts vs merges by day
panels.query: SELECT toDate(event_time) AS day, countIf(event_type = 'NewPart') AS new_parts, countIf(event_type = 'MergeParts') AS merges FROM system_anon.part_log WHERE event_date > today() - 14 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Tables driving part activity (7d)
panels.query: SELECT table AS tbl, countIf(event_type = 'NewPart') AS new_parts, countIf(event_type = 'MergeParts') AS merges, round(avgIf(duration_ms, event_type = 'MergeParts')) AS avg_merge_ms, round(merges / nullIf(new_parts, 0), 2) AS merge_ratio FROM system_anon.part_log WHERE event_date > today() - 7 AND notEmpty(table) GROUP BY tbl ORDER BY new_parts DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT table AS tbl, countIf(event_type = 'NewPart') AS new_parts, countIf(event_type = 'MergeParts') AS merges FROM system_anon.part_log WHERE event_date > today() - 7 AND notEmpty(table) GROUP BY tbl ORDER BY new_parts DESC LIMIT 3

panels.title: Heaviest tables
panels.template: **{{tbl}}** created {{new_parts|num!}} parts and ran {{merges|num}} merges in the last 7 days. A high new-part count with few merges suggests inserts are arriving in small batches — the classic micro-batching signal.
